rows.micah_quote: Self Aware Networks frames consciousness as the real-time weaving together of countless local phase-wave patterns—each one rooted in sensory or internal signals—into a single, continuously updated field. A column or cell assembly first encodes what it senses as a coefficient-of-variation in action-potential timing; hub pulses then let these local waves synchronize, so every part of the network immediately becomes part of the same oscillatory tapestry.
